This seems to have been caused by  https://github.com/llvm/llvm-project/pull/81778 (reverting fixes the issue)

Here's a small bit of IR with the same problem:
```
func.func @test(%a: index, %b: index, %memref: memref<?x?x8x1xf32>) -> vector<8x1xf32> {
  %c0 = arith.constant 0 : index
  %pad = arith.constant 0.0 : f32
  %v = vector.transfer_read %memref[%a, %b, %c0, %c0], %pad {in_bounds = [true, true]} : memref<?x?x8x1xf32>, vector<8x1xf32>
  return %v : vector<8x1xf32>
}
```
Run through `iree-opt` with `-pass-pipeline="builtin.module(func.func(iree-llvmcpu-drop-vector-unit-dims))" ` and you get:

```
error: expected result type to be 'memref<?x?x8x1xf32, strided<[?, 8, 1, 1], offset: ?>>' or a rank-reduced version. (mismatch of result layout) 
  %v = vector.transfer_read %memref[%a, %b, %c0, %c0], %pad {in_bounds = [true, true]} : memref<?x?x8x1xf32>, vector<8x1xf32>
```

cc @dcaballe, @hanhanW
Thanks for the triaging.. Apparently I missed the issue when I was on vacation.
I have a fix locally, I'll prepare the PR

issue.title: IREE compile fails for some simple dynamic matmul input

timeline.body:
This seems to have been caused by  https://github.com/llvm/llvm-project/pull/81778 (reverting fixes the issue)

Here's a small bit of IR with the same problem:
```
func.func @test(%a: index, %b: index, %memref: memref<?x?x8x1xf32>) -> vector<8x1xf32> {
  %c0 = arith.constant 0 : index
  %pad = arith.constant 0.0 : f32
  %v = vector.transfer_read %memref[%a, %b, %c0, %c0], %pad {in_bounds = [true, true]} : memref<?x?x8x1xf32>, vector<8x1xf32>
  return %v : vector<8x1xf32>
}
```
Run through `iree-opt` with `-pass-pipeline="builtin.module(func.func(iree-llvmcpu-drop-vector-unit-dims))" ` and you get:

```
error: expected result type to be 'memref<?x?x8x1xf32, strided<[?, 8, 1, 1], offset: ?>>' or a rank-reduced version. (mismatch of result layout) 
  %v = vector.transfer_read %memref[%a, %b, %c0, %c0], %pad {in_bounds = [true, true]} : memref<?x?x8x1xf32>, vector<8x1xf32>
```

cc @dcaballe, @hanhanW

issue.body:
This reverts commit b4c7152eb4f7971c111e3e2f60b55892def58d5d.

Downstream regression due to another issue that this PR exposes. We have identified the work-items to fix the new issue here: https://github.com/openxla/iree/issues/16406
